in_marathi.name: Mriganka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mriganka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mriganka is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mrig', meaning a deer. In Hindu mythology, Mriganka represents beauty, grace, and agility. It is also a symbol of strength and resilience, as a deer is known for its ability to leap over obstacles and protect its young.
